fix_summary: Fragment transaction or dialog shown after state was saved. Trigger UI from a lifecycle-aware collector (repeatOnLifecycle STARTED) or check isStateSaved.
expected_fix: Show the dialog from a lifecycle-aware collector (repeatOnLifecycle STARTED) or check isStateSaved before show().

fix_summary: Binding accessed after onDestroyView, usually from lifecycleScope instead of viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.
expected_fix: Collect in viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope with repeatOnLifecycle so collection stops at onDestroyView.

fix_summary: navigate() called twice (double tap) or from a stale destination. Check currentDestination or debounce.
expected_fix: Guard navigate() with a currentDestination check or debounce the click; it fires twice on double tap.

fix_summary: registerForActivityResult called after STARTED. Register in a field initializer or onCreate.
expected_fix: Call registerForActivityResult in a field initializer or onCreate, then launch() it from the click.

fix_summary: lateinit read before assignment. Find the code path that runs before initialisation.
expected_fix: Initialise the adapter in onViewCreated unconditionally (not only when data arrives), or guard with ::adapter.isInitialized.

fix_summary: A Java API returned null into a non-null Kotlin type. Use a nullable type or a default.
expected_fix: SharedPreferences.getString returns String?; use getString(KEY, null) ?: DEFAULT instead of a non-null type.

fix_summary: No known signature; inspect the first app frame.
expected_fix: The model's name field is non-null in Kotlin but Gson set it to null from JSON; make it nullable or use Moshi/kotlinx.serialization which enforce nullability.

fix_summary: Blocking network call on the main thread. Use suspend APIs or withContext(Dispatchers.IO).
expected_fix: Make the Retrofit call a suspend function (or withContext(Dispatchers.IO)) and launch it from viewModelScope.

fix_summary: StrictMode violation, not a crash. Move the I/O off the main thread; impact is usually debug-only.
expected_fix: Not a crash: read the theme preference via DataStore or preload SharedPreferences off the main thread.

fix_summary: Collection mutated while iterated, often from another thread. Use a snapshot copy or a thread-safe structure.
expected_fix: items is a plain ArrayList mutated from a background sync while the UI iterates it; expose an immutable snapshot via StateFlow<List<>> or guard with a Mutex.

fix_summary: Exception escaped a launch{} with no handler. Catch it inside the coroutine and surface an error state.
expected_fix: Wrap the network call in try/catch (or runCatching) inside viewModelScope.launch and expose an error/offline state; an IOException must never escape launch.

fix_summary: Emission from a different coroutine/context inside flow { }. Use flowOn or channelFlow.
expected_fix: Do not emit from inside launch/withContext within flow { }; use flowOn(Dispatchers.IO) or channelFlow for concurrent producers.

fix_summary: Heap exhausted. Large allocation = decode/sizing problem; tiny allocation = leak, needs a heap dump.
expected_fix: Decode at view size (inSampleSize / Coil or Glide) instead of full-resolution decodeFile in a list.

fix_summary: Heap exhausted. Large allocation = decode/sizing problem; tiny allocation = leak, needs a heap dump.
expected_fix: Tiny allocation failing means the heap is already full: take a heap dump (LeakCanary). EventBuffer is unbounded and holds Activity references across rotations.

fix_summary: Binder transaction over ~1MB, usually a large savedInstanceState or Intent extras. Keep only ids in bundles.
expected_fix: Something saves ~1MB into savedInstanceState (often a list in a Bundle or Fragment args). Keep only ids in bundles; hold data in a ViewModel or on disk. Use TooLargeTool to find the culprit.

fix_summary: Parcelable missing CREATOR or class stripped. Check @Parcelize setup and keep rules.
expected_fix: Filter is not a working Parcelable: apply the kotlin-parcelize plugin and annotate it with @Parcelize (and keep the class if it is obfuscated).

fix_summary: Window added after the Activity finished. Check lifecycle state before show(); prefer DialogFragment.
expected_fix: The payment callback outlives the Activity; check lifecycle state before showing, use a DialogFragment, and persist the payment result so it is not lost.

fix_summary: Dialog dismissed after its Activity was destroyed. Tie dialog lifetime to the lifecycle.
expected_fix: Dismiss only while the Activity is alive (or use a DialogFragment / Compose dialog driven by state); cancel the export job in onDestroy.

fix_summary: Duplicate key in LazyColumn/LazyRow. Keys must be unique and stable.
expected_fix: items(key = { it.id }) receives duplicate ids (e.g. the same post on two pages after pagination). De-duplicate the list or build a unique key.

fix_summary: Compose state written from a background thread. Write state on Main or use StateFlow + collectAsState.
expected_fix: mutableStateOf is read/written from Dispatchers.Default; keep Compose state on Main or use a StateFlow collected with collectAsStateWithLifecycle.

fix_summary: Runtime permission not granted. Check and request it before the call (Android 12+ split many permissions).
expected_fix: On Android 12+ request BLUETOOTH_CONNECT at runtime and check it before getBondedDevices(); declare it in the manifest.

fix_summary: Foreground service started from background on Android 12+. Use WorkManager expedited work.
expected_fix: Android 12+ forbids starting a foreground service from the background here (normal-priority push). Schedule expedited WorkManager work instead.

fix_summary: Room schema bumped without a Migration. Add the Migration (or a tested destructive fallback).
expected_fix: Add Migration(3, 4) to the Room builder and a MigrationTestHelper test; every upgrading user crashes on the home screen.

fix_summary: Resource missing for this configuration (qualifier-only folder, or stripped by shrinkResources).
expected_fix: The drawable exists only in drawable-v26 (adaptive/vector XML). Add a default drawable/ version or use AppCompatResources.getDrawable with vector support.

fix_summary: Main thread blocked on a lock. Look at what the holder thread does while holding it.
expected_fix: trimToSize writes to disk while holding the same lock get() takes on the main thread. Do disk I/O outside the lock (or use a separate disk-cache lock) so main-thread reads never wait on I/O.

fix_summary: onReceive ran too long on the main thread. Use goAsync() for short work or hand off to WorkManager.
expected_fix: onReceive does network I/O on the main thread. Enqueue a WorkManager job with a network constraint (and drop the CONNECTIVITY_CHANGE receiver).

fix_summary: Main thread blocked in a binder/IPC call (ContentResolver, system service). Move it off Main.
expected_fix: Query the contacts provider off the main thread (withContext(Dispatchers.IO) in a ViewModel) and page large result sets.

fix_summary: No known signature; inspect the first app frame.
expected_fix: After retrace: QueryValidator.isValid calls length() on a null query from a Java-interop EditText getter; treat the query as nullable.

fix_summary: Class loaded by reflection was removed or renamed by R8. Add a -keep rule.
expected_fix: R8 removed PdfExporter because it is only referenced by name via Class.forName. Add a -keep rule (or replace reflection with a direct reference / ServiceLoader).

fix_summary: Native crash. Needs symbolicated backtrace (ndk-stack with unstripped .so) for a real root cause.
expected_fix: Null dereference inside libimagefilter.so called from NativeFilter.apply. Symbolicate with ndk-stack and the unstripped .so; likely a null/freed bitmap pixel buffer passed to JNI.
